description: This file defines an interface for an autoloader within the Zend Framework's loader package. It specifies a contract that any implementing class must follow, specifically the 'autoload' method to load classes dynamically.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_Autoloader_Interface
classes.description: An interface that specifies the minimum functionality for a class autoloader in the Zend Framework.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Attempt to autoload a class given its name. Returns false if unable to load, or the class name if successful.
